build_glm4_moe_mtp_model: build a GLM-4 MTP inference model using VllmConfig for multi-token prediction
load_glm4_moe_mtp_weights: load HuggingFace checkpoint weights into a GLM-4 MoE MTP model with expert parameter mapping
compute_glm4_moe_mtp_logits: compute logits from hidden states for a GLM-4 MoE MTP model at a given spec step index
embed_glm4_moe_mtp_input_ids: embed input token IDs using the GLM-4 MoE MTP shared embedding layer
run_glm4_moe_mtp_forward: run a forward pass on the GLM-4 MoE MTP model with positions and previous hidden states
